#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, sys
compiler = '/usr/bin/gcc'
log = '/home/arobin/Work/Projects/goose-libs/libraries/goose-crypto/.build/bench/cc-gh2viwf1/commands.jsonl'
args = sys.argv[1:]
probe = any(a in args for a in ('-v', '--version', '-dumpversion', '-dumpmachine'))
effective = [compiler, *args, *([] if probe else ['-O2', '-UNDEBUG'])]
with open(log, 'a') as f: f.write(json.dumps(effective) + '\n')
os.execv(compiler, effective)
